title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Celgosivir in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis C Genotype 1 Infection
brief_summary: The objective of the study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of celgosivir for 12 weeks in patients with chronic hepatitis C genotype 1 infection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The patient must be 18 to 65 years of age, inclusive.
* Primary diagnosis of chronic HCV infection.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who did not respond or relapsed following therapy with interferon.
